import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    static final long MAXN = 1000005;
    static final long MOD = 998244353;
    static final long MODD = 1000000007;
    static long[] st = new long[15];
    static String[] good = new String[(int) MAXN];
    static int N, number;
    static List<String>[] lenn = new ArrayList[7];
    static List<Long>[][] ok = new ArrayList[7][7];
    static long[][] sum = new long[7][7];
    static final long inf = 1000000000000000000L;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            lenn[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
                ok[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
    }

    static long goal(String s) {
        long answ = 0;
        for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
            answ = answ * 10 + (c - '0');
        }
        return answ;
    }

    static BigInteger get(String cur, int max_len, int number, long[] st, List<String>[] lenn, List<Long>[][] ok, long[][] sum) {
        if (max_len == -1) return BigInteger.ZERO;
        int L = max_len / 2;
        int R = max_len - L;
        if (max_len == 1) {
            L = 1;
            R = 0;
        }
        BigInteger ans = BigInteger.valueOf((number - goal(cur) + MOD * MOD) % MOD);
        int localNumber = number + 1;
        for (String lef : lenn[L]) {
            long c = goal(cur + lef) % MOD;
            ans = ans.add(BigInteger.valueOf((-c + localNumber + MOD * MOD) % MOD));
            localNumber++;
            if (lef.length() == L) {
                long c2 = c;
                for (int oth = 1; oth <= R; ++oth) {
                    long cnst = (-c2 * st[oth] + localNumber + MOD * MOD) % MOD;
                    int to = lowerBound(ok[R][oth], MOD - cnst);
                    long sumVal = sum[R][oth];
                    int size = ok[R][oth].size();
                    ans = ans.add(BigInteger.valueOf(size).multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(cnst))
                            .add(BigInteger.valueOf(sumVal))
                            .subtract(BigInteger.valueOf(MOD).multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(size - to))));
                }
                localNumber += lenn[R].size();
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        N = String.valueOf(n).length();
        st[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 14; ++i) st[i] = st[i - 1] * 10;

        String s = String.valueOf(n);
        StringBuilder cur = new StringBuilder();

        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            good[i] = String.valueOf(i);
            String now = good[i];
            while (now.length() <= 6) {
                lenn[now.length()].add(now);
                now = "0" + now;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i) {
            for (String key : lenn[i - 1]) {
                lenn[i].add(key);
            }
            Collections.sort(lenn[i]);
            for (int j = 0; j < lenn[i].size(); ++j) {
                String keyStr = lenn[i].get(j);
                long keyVal = goal(keyStr);
                int lenKey = keyStr.length();
                ok[i][lenKey].add((j - keyVal + MOD) % MOD);
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
                Collections.sort(ok[i][j]);
                long sumVal = 0;
                for (long key : ok[i][j]) {
                    sumVal += key;
                }
                sum[i][j] = sumVal;
            }
        }

        List<Pair> Q = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= 9; ++j) {
                if (j == s.charAt(i) - '0') continue;
                if (i == 0 && j == 0) continue;
                cur.append((char) ('0' + j));
                if (j <= s.charAt(i) - '0') {
                    Q.add(new Pair(cur.toString(), s.length() - i - 1));
                } else {
                    Q.add(new Pair(cur.toString(), s.length() - i - 2));
                }
                cur.deleteCharAt(cur.length() - 1);
            }
            cur.append(s.charAt(i));
            Q.add(new Pair(cur.toString(), 0));
        }

        number = 1;
        BigInteger ans = BigInteger.ZERO;
        Collections.sort(Q);
        for (Pair key : Q) {
            if (s.charAt(key.first.length() - 1) == key.first.charAt(key.first.length() - 1)) {
                ans = ans.add(BigInteger.valueOf(( -goal(key.first) + number + MOD * MOD) % MOD));
                number++;
                continue;
            }
            ans = ans.add(get(key.first, key.second, number, st, lenn, ok, sum));
        }
        ans = ans.mod(BigInteger.valueOf(MODD));
        System.out.println(ans.toString());
    }

    static class Pair implements Comparable<Pair> {
        String first;
        int second;

        Pair(String first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }

        @Override
        public int compareTo(Pair o) {
            int cmp = this.first.compareTo(o.first);
            if (cmp != 0) return cmp;
            return Integer.compare(this.second, o.second);
        }
    }
}
